en-IN.name: Milk Man
en-IN.summary: Orders four Vijaya Gold full cream milk from Blinkit to one fixed address.
en-IN.description: Personal skill. Says the real Blinkit total and orders only after you say yes. Payment is a UPI request approved in PhonePe.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask milk man to order milk
Alexa, tell milk man to get milk
